changes.en: Close to 100 % fat against about 80 % in butter, with less water, so it spatters less in frying. It has a higher smoke point than butter.
changes.de: Fast 100 % Fett gegenüber etwa 80 % in Butter, mit weniger Wasser; es spritzt beim Braten weniger. Der Rauchpunkt liegt höher als bei Butter.

sources.title: Understanding Ingredients for the Canadian Baker (BC Cook Articulation Committee, BCcampus)
sources.place: chapter 3.3 Major Fats and Oils Used in Bakeries, section Shortening
sources.sentence: Lard and shortening have a higher fat content (close to 100%) compared to about 80% for butter and margarine.

sources.title: Understanding Ingredients for the Canadian Baker (BC Cook Articulation Committee, BCcampus)
sources.place: chapter 3.3 Major Fats and Oils Used in Bakeries, section Shortening
sources.sentence: Vegetable shortening shares many properties with lard: both are semi-solid fats with a higher smoke point than butter and margarine.

sources.title: Understanding Ingredients for the Canadian Baker (BC Cook Articulation Committee, BCcampus)
sources.place: chapter 3.3 Major Fats and Oils Used in Bakeries, section Shortening
sources.sentence: They contain less water and are thus less prone to splattering, making them safer for frying.

sources.title: McGee on Food and Cooking (Harold McGee), Hodder & Stoughton 2004
sources.place: chapter Milk and Dairy Products, Frying with Butter, p. 37
sources.sentence: Adding oil to butter does not improve its heat tolerance.
